# Test-ResourceBudgetAcceptance.ps1

Supervises the existing `build/quality/Test-ResourceBudget.ps1` without replacing or editing it. It snapshots the supplied Agent and Session Agent process identities, polls their presence and start times while the child measurement runs, preserves child stdout/stderr, locates the newly produced resource JSON, and validates sample-count consistency, timestamp span, private-working-set/CPU limits, disk-write counter presence, queue sampling, and process-ID identity. In acceptance mode it also requires external JSON evidence that the final five-minute quiet period contained zero bulk events.

Acceptance mode fixes the thresholds at 50 MiB private working set and 0.5% average CPU, requires exactly 600 seconds, at least two process IDs, and `-QuietPeriodEvidencePath`. The local quiet-period evidence file must contain `QuietPeriodStartedUtc`, `QuietPeriodCompletedUtc`, numeric `QuietPeriodSeconds` of at least 300, and integer `BulkEventCount` equal to zero; the declared duration must match its timestamps, the interval must be inside the measurement, and it must end at the measurement boundary. `-Diagnostic -ValidateOnly` checks the wrapper's prerequisites without starting a process; diagnostic execution may return zero when its shortened measurement is complete and healthy, but it is never acceptance-eligible. The wrapper writes an independent evidence JSON plus stdout/stderr logs under `artifacts/quality/resources` and returns nonzero for missing, truncated, early, identity-changed, relaxed-threshold, or otherwise incomplete evidence.

Relevant requirements: `Requirements/03_TEST_AND_QUALITY_REQUIREMENTS.md` §6 and `Requirements/19_AGENT_INTEGRATION_QUALITY.md` §6. This is a supplemental supervisor/evidence gate; the existing resource script remains the measurement implementation.
